response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling is destructive so I need a couple quick confirmations:

1) Cancel scope — cancel the entire recurring series (every Tuesday afternoon) or only the next Tuesday occurrence?  
2) Exact event title as it appears on your calendar (e.g., "Design review" or "Design review meeting") — I’ll match the title to avoid the wrong event.  
3) Notify attendees — should I send a cancellation to all attendees? If yes, do you want to include a short message to them?  
4) Time zone — use your calendar default timezone unless you want a specific one.

Reply with your choices and any message to attendees, and I’ll cancel it.
